what_it_requires: A licensed physician or other health professional must make any prior-authorization denial based on medical necessity, not the AI. Fines up to $5,000 for repeat violations.
A licensed clinician, not an algorithm alone, must make medical-necessity denials.
Rules for AI in insurers’ utilization review. Also no payment for psychotherapy delivered by AI.
Coverage decisions can’t rest only on AI.
AI can’t be the only basis to deny, delay or downgrade a prior authorization.
Insurers’ AI review tools must base decisions on the patient’s own medical history and records, not only on group data.
Payers can’t use algorithms to automatically downcode your claims.
